notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (p7, labels p6). Business-type from proprietary Total column (pp10-11): receipts = operating revenues + interest income + city sales tax; disbursements = operating expenses + interest expense (equals Statement of Activities business-type expenses 4,266,224, p2); loss on disposal of equipment (750) recorded as business_type.other_financing. Internal service fund (governmental activities) not in governmental funds statements and excluded. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp19-20, more detailed; the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule p14 is not recorded to avoid double counting); Street and LB840 from their budget schedules (pp15-16, budgetary basis); CDBG budget schedule (p17) has no actual activity; nonmajor funds per fund from p18 (Keno and Public Benefit have no activity). Departmental transfers in/out include intra-General Fund transfers between departments, recorded as printed. No detail schedule for the enterprise funds. ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents (p5); certificates of deposit in ending_investments; county treasurer cash 53,962 not included. Component unit (Community Development Agency) excluded. Read pages 1-20 of 20
